# Mount N Muscle

> Owner-operated home services across the Charlotte, NC metro — junk removal, moving, hauling, TV mounting, flooring, and handyman work. Published rates, free estimates, same-day response. 5.0 stars on Google across 100+ reviews.

## Contact
- Phone / text: 704-237-0164
- Website: https://mountnmuscle.com
- Base: Steele Creek, Charlotte, NC 28278
- Google listing: https://maps.google.com/?cid=1061662564359275114

## Junk removal — priced by the space the load takes
- One load, one trip: single item $95 · a pickup-bed load $150 · a small room $235 · a large room $315 · a one-car garage $395 · two-car garage, part cleared $475 · a full two-car garage $560 · trailer packed full $700
- Covers household and office goods. Concrete, brick, dirt, roofing, drywall and demolition debris, oversized items, and shed/deck/hot tub/pool teardowns are quoted separately. Asbestos is never accepted.
- Usable items get donated and metal gets recycled where possible.
- Surcharges: mattress or box spring +$25 each · refrigerant appliance +$40 · tire +$8 · paint, e-waste and regulated items at disposal cost

## TV mounting — flat rate
- Up to 60" $99 · 61–75" $149 · 76–85" $199 · 86" and up custom quote (two-person minimum) · over fireplace, stone or brick from $199 · each additional TV in the same visit 25% off mount labor (add-ons excluded)
- Add-ons: stick-on cord concealment $39 · in-wall cord concealment from $89 · flat mount supplied and installed $40 · full-motion mount supplied and installed $65 · protective transport box $25 per TV
- $99 is all-in for the labor: finding studs, leveling, mounting and cleanup, with travel built in

## Labor and crews
- Solo labor / handyman $70/hr ($140 minimum)
- Two-person crew $135/hr ($270 minimum)
- Trailer add-on to any crew rate: open utility trailer +$35/hr · 16ft enclosed +$60/hr
- Two-hour minimum on all hourly work, 30-minute increments after. Saturday and Sunday two-person crew bookings carry a three-hour minimum ($405, or $585 with the 16ft trailer) and no weekend surcharge. Solo handyman keeps the two-hour minimum every day.

## Flooring
- LVP / laminate $2.50/sq ft · herringbone or premium pattern $3.50/sq ft · tear-out and haul $1.00/sq ft · subfloor prep $70/hr
- Minimum 200 sq ft or $500

## Travel
- Travel is built into the number we quote — no separate trip charge

## Other add-ons
- Stairs +$25 per flight above the first · heavy or awkward item from +$40 · same-day or emergency +$40 · Sunday +15% on flat-rate jobs only, never on hourly crew work
- Card payments carry a 3.5% processing fee. Cash, check, and Zelle also accepted.

## Service areas
Charlotte, Huntersville, Concord, Mooresville, Matthews, Pineville, Ballantyne, Mount Holly, Gastonia, Waxhaw, Stallings, Indian Trail (NC) · Fort Mill, Tega Cay, Lake Wylie, Rock Hill (SC)

## Promotions
One promotion per booking — discounts never stack. WELCOME10 gives 10% off a first booking for residents of partner properties.

## Referrals
Friends & Neighbors referral credit — $25 credit to whoever refers and $25 off the new customer's first booking. Anyone counts: friends, neighbors, family, coworkers. Three booked referrals earns $100 credit or a free hour of solo labor. Property managers and realtor teams get custom account rates.

## Policies
- Estimates are free. We stand by our price: the number confirmed before work starts is the number you pay, unless more is added or something wasn't in the photos
- Cancel or reschedule free with 24 hours' notice
- We cannot haul asbestos, hazardous chemicals, fuel, solvents, pressurized tanks or ammunition. Heavy material like concrete and dirt is quoted per trip
- 5.0 stars across 100+ Google reviews. Reviews live on the Google Business Profile; no discounts are offered in exchange for reviews
